# Top CRM Tools for Small Consulting Firms

Here's a comparison of six well-regarded CRM platforms suited to consulting practices, based on commonly reported features and pricing tiers (verify current pricing directly with vendors, as it changes frequently).

## Comparison Table

| CRM | Starting Price/User/Mo | Typical Rating (G2/Capterra) | Best For |
|---|---|---|---|
| **HubSpot CRM** | Free tier; paid from ~$20 | 4.4–4.5/5 | Solo consultants, marketing-heavy firms |
| **Pipedrive** | ~$14–24 | 4.2–4.5/5 | Sales-pipeline-focused consultants |
| **Zoho CRM** | ~$14–40 | 4.0–4.3/5 | Budget-conscious, need customization |
| **Salesforce Essentials/Starter** | ~$25–80 | 4.2–4.4/5 | Scaling firms, complex client needs |
| **Insightly** | ~$29–49 | 4.0–4.2/5 | Project-based consulting, PM integration |
